what: Generative nature soundscapes: wind, sea, rain, fire, birds and thunder, mixing and changing by themselves. White keys latch a scene, black keys play events (thunder, wave, gust, downpour), key pressure pushes the weather. A pixel-art scene on screen follows the sound. Built on Felucca.
author: Gorgonzola777
sounds: CC0: VSCO-2 Community Edition and VCSL by Versilian Studios (Felucca's sample pack, assets/samples-cc0); NATURE's own sounds are synthesised
